fixedDefects.after: Minimal per-tab pending metadata is bound to verified user/Store/role. Explicit retry preserves intent/key after reload, including a committed approval whose response was lost. Identity replacement discards old metadata; unavailable storage blocks dispatch.

Demotion and revocation at protected catalog, assignment and Refund decision writes do not create privileged effects.

The authorized Staff list and summary contain only its assigned Order.
Foreign Product/Variant identities exercised across schema, preview, ordinary edits, create, CSV and upload/delete paths with Owner B and Staff B.
Requests are concealed or rejected at the appropriate boundary; private A instructions, unchanged product data and R2/import state are checked.
Direct cross-Store Refund/Order and Refund-history references fail foreign keys.
Otherwise-identical valid same-Store rows succeed; foreign_key_check is empty.
The existing user_owner_a opened the migrated paid legacy Order in the real Console.
Original Order/line/payment/history rows, references and legacy provenance matched before and after browser access.
The preservation comparison was captured before subsequent disposable browser fixtures were added.
Membership targeting an absent Store is rejected by foreign keys; the account gains no automatic membership and is denied.
Deleting a referenced Store is also rejected; an existing valid Store B membership still resolves to B.
Malformed JSON, null/array bodies, missing or invalid identities, unsupported authority fields, malformed paths and unsupported decision actions are rejected.
Business rows, audit history and command ledgers remain unchanged on these failures.
Forged Owner/actor/Store/status fields do not upgrade Staff on payment, fulfillment, cancellation, refund request, assignment, decision or catalog mutation paths.
Assigned Staff invalid-body and foreign Staff concealed paths leave no unauthorized effects.
SQL-shaped cursors are rejected. A separate real browser/API probe persisted a SQL-shaped Customer name and found exactly that one Order using q; an unrelated 26-Order query remained intact.
Prior real-browser literal HTML/script rendering evidence in both apps is retained; all current browser and E2E regressions passed.
Real default 25/26 Staff pagination, last-item reassignment, empty cursor response, updated total 25 and original first-page return are verified.
The browser repeated the same boundary with real filtered Staff requests; Previous remained usable, the moved Order disappeared, and Next was disabled after returning.
The misleading empty-page scope and impossible page denominator were reproduced and corrected.
105 unsupported-provider sign-ins include rate-limited responses and run alongside malformed public requests.
A legitimate Owner assignment, assigned Staff read, public Order creation and Owner catalog read still succeed without extra payment or assignment effects.
Console and Customer resubmission after both approval and rejection return the unchanged original request and terminal status.
A changed reason does not reopen the request or duplicate request history.
Matching Product slugs and Variant SKUs in A/B remain isolated.
A global Variant ID collision is rejected without replacing the original row; Google identity no-op/conflict and provisioning gates remain green.
Real session-table and capability-table faults return sanitized 503/500 responses; deeply inspected error/warn/log/info output does not expose supplied credentials or Customer private values.

A separate anonymous browser exercised valid and wrong capabilities: no capability appeared in network URLs, Referer, browser diagnostics or rendered failure text; headers were confined to the exact private endpoint.
Only sanitized facts and screenshots without bearer links are retained.
Staff cannot indirectly remove purchased delivery through direct deletion, Variant disable/inheritance changes, schema removal or unsupported Product deletion.
A permitted Owner file detach retains the paid Order snapshot, original purchased object bytes and payment reference.
Native keyboard type-ahead selected Staff; Enter submitted/retried; a duplicate activation did not create a second intent.
A keyboard Refund rejection received a real 409 after another operation approved it. Chrome exposes an assertive atomic alert and Tab continues to an enabled control.
